summary: The frozen task satisfies the current Edition 3 structural/environment rules visible to this controller. Required task metadata is top-level, the separate agent/verifier images use the same digest-pinned canonical Debian base, verifier Python dependency is pinned at image build time, the agent build copies only the solver environment, and .dockerignore excludes solution/tests and common repository clutter. Public networking matches the current Edition 3 default. Deterministic preflight, Ruff, Docker setup, Oracle and NOP all pass on the frozen merge ref.

evidence.observation: Current canonical shape requires top-level category/subcategory/tags/languages/difficulty/expert estimate/artifacts and defaults network_mode to public.
Required top-level metadata is correctly nested; verifier is separate; 10800s agent and 1800s verifier timeouts are within current bounds; resources are ordinary CPU/RAM/storage.
Digest-pinned Debian bookworm-slim base; one clean apt install; tmux/asciinema present; only eod/ is copied into the solver image.
Excludes .git, caches, env files, solution, tests and archives from agent build context.
Separate digest-pinned verifier image; pytest is pinned to 8.4.1 at build time.
No runtime package installation or network fetch; binary reward is explicitly written.
Preflight, Ruff, Docker/STB, Oracle/NOP and large-system complexity checks pass on merge ref 20b2da243... .
Entire deterministic evidence archive is about 0.6 MiB; the text-only solver environment represented inside it is far below the 100 MiB build-context ceiling.

do_not_change: Do not move top-level task.toml fields back under metadata.
Do not copy solution/ or tests/ into the agent image.
Do not add unpinned non-apt runtime dependencies or Docker/socket privileges.
next_gate: Instruction and Documentation reviews, then Comprehensive Reviewer
